info.title: Aseman VMM API
info.description: A501: the only interface between an Aseman node and a VMM (plan 04). States and generation rules are in `states.json` (A502, A503). Every request is authenticated by mutual TLS: the client certificate names the calling node; the VMM serves only that node's workloads.

101.description: WebSocket upgrade, subprotocol `aseman.terminal.v1`. Text frames are JSON: client `{"type":"stdin","data":base64}` and `{"type":"resize","cols":n,"rows":n}`; server `{"type":"stdout"|"stderr","data":base64}` and a final `{"type":"exit","code":n}`.

post.description: Stateless; needs a runtime with `execution_proofs`. An invalid proof is `valid: false`, not a problem.

ProblemCode.description: Stable machine code; clients branch on it, never on `title` or `detail`.

current_generation.description: With `stale_generation`: the generation the VMM applied.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. Never carries credentials, workload output, or backend internals.

ResourceVersion.description: Opaque; changes on every change to the record, desired or observed. Sent as a quoted ETag.

reference.description: `blob`: an ADR 0027 BlobStore key; `oci`: an image reference.

Artifact.description: Content-addressed input; the VMM verifies the digest before use.

egress_allow.description: Hosts the workload may reach, resolved by Aseman from `network.egress` grants. Empty denies all egress.

NetworkPolicy.description: Deny by default: nothing is reachable in either direction unless listed.

credential.description: Short-lived workload credential (A405). Write-only: never returned, logged, or placed in events.

Bootstrap.description: How the workload reaches the Aseman guest API; it gets no other Aseman access.

entry.description: Module path or command inside the artifact.

WorkloadLabels.description: Ownership labels set by the node. The VMM never derives authority from them.

sequence.description: Provider-local; orders observations of one generation.

CreateWorkload.description: The node chooses the ID, so a retried create names the same workload.

key.description: The signal key the program handles.

payload.description: Any JSON value, at most 4 MiB encoded.

Invocation.description: One event for the workload: runs the program once (invocation runtimes) or is delivered to the running instance.

port.description: Ingress port name; the first `http` port when absent.

output.description: The program's JSON output, if any.

proof.description: With `execution_proofs`: the execution proof, unpadded base64url.

VerificationRequest.description: A proof of one execution of `program` on `inputs` producing `outputs`.

Usage.description: Cumulative counters for the window; `sequence` lets metering deduplicate (P6 finance).

WorkloadEvent.description: `resync` tells the reader its position expired: list workloads again, then resume.

RuntimeCapabilities.description: An operation a runtime does not support is refused with `unsupported_operation`, never degraded.

DeployConventions.description: How the runtime's program files are deployed.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every mutation. A replay with the same key and body returns the first response; the same key with another body is `idempotency_key_reused`. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Optional quoted resource version; a mismatch is `resource_version_mismatch` (412).

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Echoed in responses, problems, operations, and logs; generated when absent.

Traceparent.name: traceparent
Traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context, propagated to the backend.

Deadline.name: Aseman-Deadline
Deadline.description: Unix milliseconds after which the caller no longer wants the result; the VMM gives up with `deadline_exceeded` and cancels the operation.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Resume a stream after this sequence.

Accepted.description: The operation was recorded; poll it or follow the workload's events.
